name: Sketchbook
why: Sixteen ideas to mix and match in the Session and Scene views: launch the drums from one, the bass from another, the chords from a third; change a track's sound (Y) to hear an idea on another; keep what works as a new scene. Darker and minimal, every part on a sound that moves by itself (pack 8) or one from your palette (pack 7). Two basses (the pulsing bass and the delayed FM round), two chord tracks (muted keys struck, a low drone held), a lead (your FM marimba) and an arp.

sections.name: Sketchbook: Pulse
sections.why: The pulsing bass on one held note, the drone under it, the deep four and dark 16ths: everything moving by itself.

sections.name: Sketchbook: Shadow
sections.why: Three bars of A minor and one of B flat a semitone above; the arp in threes against the four.

sections.name: Sketchbook: Eraser
sections.why: A stuttering kick and hats, the delayed bass's three notes, the marimba off the grid.

sections.name: Sketchbook: Deep dub
sections.why: The broken kick with space, the rim off the backbeat, the echoing bass falling, dub stabs on the keys, a few notes on the marimba.

sections.name: Sketchbook: Half light
sections.why: Half time with a soft snare on the 3, the bass gliding under keys falling A minor, G, F, the arp on the off 16ths.

sections.name: Sketchbook: Night drive
sections.why: An arpeggiated bass under A minor then E minor, the arp up and down above it, the drone holding.

sections.name: Sketchbook: Kick and space
sections.why: Hardly anything: the kick on the 1 and the and of 2, a rim, the pulsing bass, the marimba's seven steps.

sections.name: Sketchbook: Slow toms
sections.why: Low toms in threes under A minor 11 and F major 7, the bass walking down.

sections.name: Sketchbook: Falling keys
sections.why: The keys struck off the beat falling, a bass in the pocket, the marimba low.

sections.name: Sketchbook: Sigh
sections.why: Half time, A minor and the half-diminished II: a sigh and home, the bell-like marimba falling.

sections.name: Sketchbook: Minor four, five
sections.why: D minor, E minor, home to A minor; wood and logs, the keys syncopated, the arp in fives.

sections.name: Sketchbook: Open fifths
sections.why: Bare fifths then fourths on A: the broken kick, the echoed bass, the arp in threes.

sections.name: Sketchbook: Stutter dub
sections.why: The stutter groove under dub stabs, the pulsing bass playing the dub line.

sections.name: Sketchbook: Drone
sections.why: No kick: wood and logs, the gliding bass, the drone, a few notes off the grid. A breakdown to launch between the others.

sections.name: Sketchbook: Rolling, slow
sections.why: Toms in threes, the arpeggiated bass, the keys once a bar, the marimba in sevens: polyrhythms, slowly.

sections.name: Sketchbook: Everything moving
sections.why: All of it at once: both basses, the drone, the arp and the marimba. Take parts away from here.
